newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish currency reserves fall to $21.57 bln in Sep.
newsitem.headline: Polish currency reserves fall to $21.57 bln in Sep.

text.p: Polish net foreign currency reserves fell by $262 million in September to $21.57 billion and were $3.02 billion higher than a year ago, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said net reserves grew $1.14 billion in the
January-September period compared to a $7.26 billion rise in
the corresponding period of last year.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dollars) SEPTEMBER AUGUST SEPT 95
NOTE - Official reserves are those held by the state. Net
reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
